reference.title: Scenario 7: system requirements in a reference topic
reference.shortdesc: Consider a "System Requirements" chapter in an "Installation Reference Guide" document where you want to

section.p: Consider a "System Requirements" chapter in an "Installation Reference Guide" document where you want to provide the minimum and recommended hardware and software requirements for the application.
section.codeblock: <reference id="system-requirements"> <title>System Requirements</title> <shortdesc> Review the minimum and recommended system requirements before installing the application. </shortdesc> <refbody> <section> <title>Hardware Requirements</title> <simpletable relcolwidth="2* 1* 1*"> <sthead> <stentry>Component</stentry> <stentry>Minimum</stentry> <stentry>Recommended</stentry> </sthead> <strow> <stentry>CPU</stentry> <stentry>2 Cores</stentry> <stentry>4 Cores</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Memory</stentry> <stentry>8 GB RAM</stentry> <stentry>16 GB RAM</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Storage</stentry> <stentry>20 GB</stentry> <stentry>50 GB SSD</stentry> </strow> </simpletable> </section> <section> <title>Software Requirements</title> <dl> <dlentry> <dt>Operating System</dt> <dd> Windows 10, Windows 11, or Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS. </dd> </dlentry> <dlentry> <dt>Java Runtime</dt> <dd> Java 17 or later. </dd> </dlentry> <dlentry> <dt>Database</dt> <dd> PostgreSQL 15 or later. </dd> </dlentry> </dl> </section> </refbody> </reference>
section.p: Result: Using a combination of <simpletable> for hardware requirement comparisons and <dl>(definition list) for software dependencies and environmental requirements provides structured lookup information while keeping the content easy to maintain and reuse.
